name: On Iron Pauldrons
label: Quest
description: On Iron Pauldrons: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Orokk sees the eagerness in your eyes, friend. Like a sponge you soak in the wisdom of the Omosh.
Return to the anvil, soak in the heat of the forge, create for Orokk four bronze battleaxes and four bronze warhammers. Only then will you learn of the iron pauldron.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You do Orokk proud, friend. Read, learn of iron shoulders!
